The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations. I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message.

Two sources Marcus can see himself back this up:
- Dana's #north-team post from Aug 20, 2025 says Thea flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift.
- The public North cheat sheet lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

A contact is account information, not a finance figure, and Marcus is on the North team, so it was fine to share in the channel.
